verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own marketing says bot management is built into the network and runs on every request, which covers the core of protecting an app from bot traffic. Nothing in the evidence describes an invisible or challenge-based mechanism, or how a Worker developer configures or verifies it. missing for 10: documentation of invisible challenge-based verification (e.g. a challenge widget and server-side token validation), developer-facing setup/integration docs for Workers apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my app from automated bot traffic with invisible challenge-based protection

citations.quote: DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request from day one.
